Garlic Oil [BOOM 0107]

Prep: 5 minutesYield: 1 quartShelf life: 3 days

Allergen call out: None of the Top 9 allergens.

Ingredients

AmountIngredient
150 gTILL Garlic Base [TILL008]
~750 gBlended Oil

Method

  1. Add garlic base. Put 150 g TILL Garlic Base into a clear 32 oz squeeze bottle.
  2. Fill with oil. Fill the bottle with blended oil (~750 g).
  3. Cap & shake. Screw on the cap and shake well.
  4. Label, date & rotate. Apply a PrepWizard label, date and rotate.

LEAN Working

Stage the bottle, funnel, garlic base and blended oil together before filling.

Before You Start

Have a clear 32 oz squeeze bottle, cap, funnel and PrepWizard label ready.
